name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior mining company engaged in mineral royalty creation, acquisition, and gold exploration in Nevada and Idaho. The company operates a three-pronged business model encompassing royalty creation, precious-metals streaming, and an exploration accelerator. Key assets include royalty interests on the Lapon Canyon Project in Mineral County, Nevada, where the company holds a 2% NSR royalty and a 50% earn-in exploration agreement.
